subject: Medford Charter Review
overview: Host Danielle Balocca discussed a recent police complaint with David McKenna and interviewed Milva McDonald about ongoing efforts to initiate a charter review in Medford.

items.title: Medford Police Department Complaint
items.summary: David McKenna detailed a public complaint regarding a police stop of two local graduates and described a community letter calling on the mayor to address city public safety standards.

items.title: Discussion on Charter Review
items.summary: Milva McDonald explained the structure of Medford's Plan A charter, potential updates like ward representation and term limits, and the Medford Charter Review Coalition's efforts to trigger a review process.
